image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a large common iguana resting on rocky terrain. The iguana is facing right, displaying its profile. It has greyish-green skin with darker banding, a prominent dorsal crest of spines running down its neck and back, and a large circular subtympanic shield below the ear. The dewlap is visible but not fully extended. The front left limb is clearly visible with clawed digits gripping the rock. The background consists of out-of-focus grey stones.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is distinctly triangular and large relative to the body. A loose fold of skin (dewlap) is clearly visible hanging from the throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the eye is large, the iris appears pale blue-grey or white rather than the specified 'golden'. The pupil is round, but the coloration mismatch fails the strict checkpoint criteria.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very distinct, large, pale circular scale is clearly visible on the cheek, directly below the ear opening (tympanum). This is a hallmark feature of the species.
The torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust build.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana exhibits greyish-green coloration with darker, broad vertical bands on the flank, matching the description for an adult or sub-adult.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A continuous row of sharp, spine-like scales is clearly visible starting from the neck and extending down the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution texture shows fine granular scales on the body and larger, smoother plates on the snout and cheek area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front limb is muscular. The foot clearly shows multiple long digits with claws. While not all 5 digits are perfectly splayed due to perspective, the structure is anatomically correct and consistent with pentadactyl limbs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame behind the iguana. Its full length and lateral compression cannot be verified from this cropped view.

artifact_observations.location: Subtympanic shield and surrounding cheek scales
artifact_observations.reasoning: The large circular scale (subtympanic shield) has an unnaturally smooth, almost plastic-like gradient compared to the highly detailed granular texture of the adjacent skin. It lacks the micro-texture expected in a high-fidelity macro shot.

artifact_observations.location: Claws of the front left foot
artifact_observations.reasoning: The tips of the claws show slight smearing/melting into the rock surface, lacking the sharp edge definition seen in the rest of the image. Likely a minor generation artifact or depth-of-field inconsistency.
